$comment: The chronicle SDK contract (chronicle-hq design 12): the wire described once, restated by every SDK. The Go contract package proves it matches; an SDK generates its types, constants and error enum from it and nothing else. The words are the user's (chronicle-hq/00-META/vocabulary.md, decision 0044): a store, its types, their instances named by paths, children, snapshots; the protocol tokens underneath — subjects, verb names, headers, resource names, the log. META prefix — do not change with the words. Since decision 0057 every verb's subject carries the caller — CHRON.API.<principal>.<VERB…>, the caller's alone under the member baseline — and no request carries a principal; an operation may be written through the node, which attests its author.

shapes.name: request-reply
shapes.description: one request, one reply; no responder is a typed error. The control verbs, and the verified write

shapes.name: streamed-reply
shapes.description: one request; chunks and a trailer from one responder; ends on the trailer, a stall or the deadline is the safety net

shapes.name: scatter-gather
shapes.description: one request, any responder may answer; ends on a deadline or a count; zero answers is an empty result. Not on chronicle's wire: an application's own

shapes.name: batch-publish
shapes.description: many messages, one commit ack: the server's atomic batch publish. Described, unbuilt until a consumer exists

shapes.name: publish
shapes.description: a guarded JetStream publish: every direct append

shapes.name: subscribe
shapes.description: a resumable JetStream read — an ordered consumer or a KV scan or watch — never a core subscription

operation.Nats-Msg-Id: the op ID and the dedup key, made once by the writer, kept across retries
operation.Op-Type: the operation's kind in the log's vocabulary
operation.Op-Author: the principal ID: stamped by the SDK from the credentials on a direct append; bound to the caller by the node on a verified write
operation.Op-Parents: the op IDs the writer had seen, one header value per parent

guards.Nats-Rollup: a snapshot that replaces its subject's history; only ever the rollup subject value

stream.Chron-Chunk: a message's position in a streamed reply, from 1, increasing by one; the trailer continues the numbering
stream.Chron-End: marks the trailer; carries the count of items sent across every chunk

serviceError.Nats-Service-Error-Code: a code from the error catalog

attestation.Op-Attester: the public key of the node that attested the author (decision 0057); present only on an operation written through the node
attestation.Op-Signature: the node's Ed25519 signature over the record's signed form, base64
attestation.signedForm: subject, Nats-Msg-Id, Op-Type, Op-Author, Op-Parents joined with ',', Op-Ts as sent (empty when unset), Op-Version (defaulted), and the hex SHA-256 of the payload — one per line, joined with '\n'

instanceToken.note: one segment of an instance's path; a path is the segments joined with '/' as the user writes it, and with '.' as it is stored — the tail, which is also the state bucket's key

path.note: type/id, then name/id for each child, e.g. invoice/inv-1/comments/c-3; converted to and from the stored tail segment for segment

derivations.upperStore: the store name uppercased with '-' mapped to '_'

memberBaseline.note: what every member holds (design 01, decision 0057); <principal> is the member's own name — the server's {{name()}} template where one scope serves every member

children.description: {name → type}: the child types that may live under an instance of this type

precondition.description: a JSON Schema the instance's current state must satisfy for the operation to take effect (decision 0059); absent, the operation applies in any state

seq.description: the stream sequence the state was folded to
the stream sequence — the only order

verified.description: the reader's finding: Op-Signature verifies against an attester key META lists; false for every operation written directly

verified_authors.description: the store requires verified authors (decision 0057): an operation the node did not attest is kept in the history and marked out of the state; the SDKs write to it through the node

fold.rules: resolve the tail (the path as stored) first: an undeclared child (one its parent type does not declare) is marked and moves nothing; a snapshot resets state to its payload's, judged against the instance schema when typed; a declared merge applies RFC 7386 onto current state, empty included; none, an unknown type, an unknown effect, a bad record or an invalid payload moves nothing; an untyped subject moves only by snapshot; in a store that requires verified authors, an op whose attestation is absent or does not verify against an attester key in META is marked unverified and moves nothing (decision 0057); an op whose operation declares a precondition the current state does not satisfy — the empty object when the thing has none — is marked precondition-unmet and moves nothing, and a declared merge whose result fails the thing schema is marked off-schema and moves nothing: the schema is the shape every derived state keeps (decision 0059)

errors.meaning: the service failed; the description says how
the request body does not decode, or a required field is missing
the principal's role does not admit the verb
the principal is not a member of the account
the store name is outside [a-z0-9-]+ or reserved
the index name is outside [a-z0-9-]+
the type name is outside [a-z0-9-]+
the principal name is outside [a-z0-9-]+ or reserved
the instance path has a segment outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+
the role is outside the vocabulary (admin, writer, reader)
the history policy is outside the vocabulary (compactable, full)
the index kind is outside the vocabulary (search, graph, semantic)
the index config does not parse under its kind's contract
a JSON Schema in the type record does not compile
an operation's effect is outside the vocabulary (merge, none)
an operation's name is not a valid op type
a child name is outside [a-z0-9-]+
a child names a type outside [a-z0-9-]+
the query's op is outside the index kind's vocabulary
the graph direction is outside the vocabulary (out, in, both)
the store already exists
the index is already declared
the member is already registered
the store does not exist
the index is not declared
the instance has no history in the store
state is not an index a caller declares or deletes; it is read as the instance's state
the semantic kind's embedding provider did not answer
the record names an author other than the caller the subject carries
the type defines no such operation
the created type is not among its parent type's children
the data fails the operation's schema, or the state fails the type's
the instance already exists
the instance moved past the expected sequence
the environment's role responder did not answer, or answered outside the vocabulary; the request is refused, never answered from the registry
membership is managed where the roles live: the roles come from the environment's responder, and the member verbs have nothing to record
the operation's precondition is not met by the instance's current state
the state after the operation would fail the type's schema

interactions.name: append
interactions.subject: CHRON.<store>.OPS.<tail>
interactions.payload: data only; a snapshot op's payload is {state, frontier}
interactions.preflight: validate the payload against the type's operation schema; refuse a create under an undeclared child; one in-flight publish per subject
interactions.retry: keep Nats-Msg-Id across retries; after a guard refusal read the subject's last op and compare IDs: equal is landed, different is instance-moved
interactions.$comment: the direct route: asserted authorship — the author is the writer's word (decision 0057); the verified route is the apply interaction
interactions.attestation: an operation written through the node also carries Op-Attester and Op-Signature; a direct publish never sets them

interactions.name: history
interactions.source: ordered consumer on LOG_<STORE> filtered to CHRON.<store>.OPS.<tail> — or, with children, to that subject and everything under it, CHRON.<store>.OPS.<tail>.> (decision 0049)
interactions.start: sequence 1 (Replay) or after a given sequence (FoldTail)
interactions.bounded: at the stream head observed at the start

seq.description: the stream sequence — the only order

verified.description: the author is verified: Op-Signature verifies against an attester key META lists

interactions.name: tail
interactions.source: ordered consumer on LOG_<STORE> filtered to CHRON.<store>.OPS.>, one instance's subject, or — with children — that subject and everything under it (decision 0049)
interactions.start: sequence 1, after a given sequence, or new only

seq.description: the stream sequence — the only order

verified.description: the author is verified: Op-Signature verifies against an attester key META lists
